goal: Validate Phase 1 native foundation integration with a preview debug APK and recorded device evidence.
non_goals: Do not implement new Android feature behavior.
Do not mark Phase 2+ legacy entries as verified.
Do not build signed or release APKs.
Do not modify existing mobile/ Capacitor/PWA release packaging.
Do not touch signing files, alias reverse-tutor, or existing applicationId com.reversetutor.app.
Do not claim native replacement readiness.
acceptance_criteria: Focused Phase 1 unit and instrumentation checks pass.
Project-level native test and lint checks pass.
Preview debug APK installs and launches on the connected Android device.
Device validation records launch, navigation, back behavior, settings/about reachability, device identity, Android version, screenshots/XML, and result.
Coverage registry remains conservative and does not close non-verified P0 rows.
verification_expectations: Run focused Phase 1 JVM tests for app shell, data preferences, and settings models.
Run connected data instrumentation if an ADB device is available.
Run native project test, lint, and app assembleDebug.
Inspect debug APK package id and confirm it remains com.reversetutor.preview.
Install preview debug APK on the connected device and capture launch/navigation/settings/about/back evidence.
Use app pid/package-specific logcat filtering to avoid global AndroidRuntime false positives.
Validate ADworkflo JSON artifacts with ConvertFrom-Json.
notes: This task is a validation gate for Phase 1 foundation, not a feature implementation task.
The preview APK is not a signed or official replacement APK.
The legacy coverage registry remains the source of truth for replacement blockers.
